title: Euromillions Superdraw, Irish and American jackpots are primed!
heading: Weekend Lottery Roundup
description: LottoExpress.com is this weekend's lotto destination! Play Euromillions Superdraw, or soar to new heights with Irish and American jackpots.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
There are fantastic opportunities to explore for our lottery spend this week. The Irish Lotto – and it’s comparatively favourable jackpot odds leads the way. Furthermore we have a pre-announced Superdraw and the annual Summer Gordo extravaganza to prepare for.

Your Irish Lucky Charm Keeps Climbing

The Irish Lotto jackpot now sits at €12.5 million!… March 18 was the last time the Irish Lotto had a jackpot winner. We’ve seen TWENTY-FIVE rollovers since that date!

This Saturday’s jackpot is definitely worth a flutter… particularly when saving 45% off the regular price at Lotto Express when you purchase five Irish Lotto boards.

Check it out now and get into the action!

Saturday 24th June marks the date for the next Australian Superdraw and lottery enthusiasts around the world are eagerly anticipating this not-to-be-missed event.

The June 24th Division 1 jackpot will be an astounding $30 million – promising life-changing winnings for the fortunate winner(s). It’s an extraordinary event featuring a special SUPER-SIZED minimum jackpot guarantee. This Australian Superdraw offers a minimum guaranteed jackpot of $30 million regardless of whether there was a carryover from the preceding draw of Australia’s Saturday Lotto.

Now available! Summer Gordo

Sorteo extraordinaio de Vacaciones, or Summer Gordo as it is commonly called, is one of the planet’s biggest lottery events of the season. This draw happens only once a year during the first weekend of July to mark the start of summer holidays.

Adding to the excitement and anticipation, €140,000,000 is available in aggregate prizing. Lotto Express has exclusive syndicate plays available for this can’t miss event.

Hurry now and reserve your Summer Gordo play at LottoExpress.com

Good Luck everybody on your weekend plays.
